news.summary: According to Elorian's evaluations, Glimpse outperforms even GPT-6 Astra on scientific chart reasoning and short-form video captioning, with competitive results on other visual reasoning tasks.

news.title: China plans to tighten export controls on open-weight models and 23 key AI technologies
news.summary: China plans to restrict exports of 23 key AI technologies, including model weights, source code, and training methods for systems hitting 10^26 FLOPs or 2 trillion parameters.

news.title: Is AI interpretability close to a breakthrough? A new essay has researchers divided
news.summary: Neural networks may be much easier to read than researchers assumed, with about 90 percent of neurons serving a clear function.

news.title: Mark Wahlberg on using AI in film ‘the right way’ and being open to an AI clone carrying on his legacy
news.summary: Actor and angel investor Mark Wahlberg says he's OK with using AI in filmmaking, provided it's used "to enhance what you're doing."

news.title: Replit’s CEO says the future of work is the ‘self-driving company’
news.summary: Replit CEO Amjad Masad envisions a future of “self-driving companies,” where AI agents handle day-to-day tasks and people focus on higher-level decisions.

news.title: ChatGPT becomes a full Chrome browser assistant that reads and acts on your open tabs
news.summary: OpenAI's updated Chrome extension lets ChatGPT access open browser tabs, sum up content, and use "Computer Use" in Work mode to fill out forms or compare products across several tabs.
